# cache/

`cached_run.json` is a simulated conversation between two LLMs (a persona agent and a scripted scammer).
All indicators (UPI IDs, phone numbers, URLs, account numbers) are **fake values** planted in the scam script — they are not real financial or personal data.

This file enables **Replay mode** in the Streamlit dashboard, allowing judges to see the full demo experience with zero LLM API calls.
